item.title: [SwiftHFR] LOT-118 follow-up: swipe-delete race, weak profile hook, footers, VoiceOver
item.body:
Closes #687 (the Mac check is on #640)
Claim: cloud/i687-sonnet
Author model: Sonnet 5.5

**Problem.** The LOT-118 review left five small findings: a swipe-delete turned offsets into pseudos inside its background task (two quick swipes could remove the wrong member or flash a row back), a weak-capture rule broken by the profile hook, footers reworded against legacy, an outdated spec paragraph, and silent profile list buttons for VoiceOver.

**Change.**
1. `PseudoListEditorModel.remove(at:)` is synchronous up to the write: it resolves the pseudos and drops them from the list at swipe time, then chains the writes in one task; the list is read again only when the last pending removal is done. The view calls it directly.
2. `TopicReaderView.makeController` builds one `[weak model]` closure for the profile hook.
3. Footers are legacy's words again (`AppSettingsView.swift:671-678` @ 2fe43da3).
4. LOT-118 spec: avatar menu paragraph updated (#638 merged).
5. Profile list feedback is announced to VoiceOver (`AccessibilityNotification.Announcement`).

**Tests.** `twoQuickSwipesRemoveTheTwoSwipedMembers` (PseudoListTests.swift); on the old code `remove(at:)` was `async` and resolved offsets in the task, so the second swipe hit the wrong row. Reviewed by Opus 5.5, APPROVE on f32fa36 (3 rounds). Not run: the cloud cannot build the app; CI will.

### Mac check: LOT-118 follow-up (#687), swipe-delete and the profile's list toggle

Setup: build `fddb6a37` (dev-swift head, includes this PR), Debug, unsigned. iPad Pro 13" (M5) simulator, iOS 27.0, landscape. Logged out, so the global **Liste blanche** was used: the per-account Liste noire needs a login, and the unsigned build cannot use the Keychain. All pseudos added were fake (`fixture…`) and removed afterwards. A real member's profile was opened read-only, and its love-list toggle was set and then reset.

| # | Step | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Réglages › Liste blanche: add 4 fake pseudos, then swipe-delete the 2nd and the 4th back to back (swipe → Supprimer → swipe → Supprimer; 3.9 s between the two deletes, the fastest the UI driver allows) | 🟢 Exactly the two swiped rows are gone. The other two stay in order, no row flashes back |
| 2 | Terminate and relaunch, reopen Liste blanche | 🟢 The same two pseudos, so the saved list matches what was shown |
| 3 | Clean-up: delete the last two | 🟢 "Aucun pseudo whitelisté." |
| 4 | Reader › avatar menu (Profil, Whitelist) › Profil › "Ajouter à la love list" | 🟢 Accessibility element: a **Button** labelled "Ajouter à la love list" (no value). After the tap the same button reads "Retirer de la love list", and the feedback line below says "BOUM BOUM ! ‹pseudo› ajouté à la love list ♥" |
| 5 | Tap again | 🟢 Label back to "Ajouter à la love list". Feedback "OH NOES ! ‹pseudo› a été supprimé de la love list" |

**Limits**
- Step 1 is not the sub-second double swipe of the race in the new test: XCUITest takes about 2 s per action, and a fast full-swipe drag did not trigger the full-swipe delete on the simulator. The race itself is covered by `twoQuickSwipesRemoveTheTwoSwipedMembers`. Two quick swipes with a finger are worth a try on the device.
- The spoken **VoiceOver announcement** (`AccessibilityNotification.Announcement` posted with the feedback text) cannot be heard or captured on the simulator: it needs a device with VoiceOver on. Steps 4–5 show only that the button exposes the right label and trait, and that the announced text changes on each toggle.

**Left for the operator (device):** VoiceOver on, profile › love list (and liste noire, logged in): the toggle is announced each time, including the same toggle twice. Two quick swipe-deletes with a finger in Liste noire / Liste blanche. Neither was run on the connected iPhone: it holds the operator's real lists, and VoiceOver cannot be driven remotely.
